description: #3830 — the other half of `query_reminder_settings.json`: `get_reminder_settings` with NO `app_settings` seed at all answers `ReminderSettings::default()` — off, `09:00` — on both stacks. Non-vacuous only as a pair: this fixture alone is satisfied by a mock that ignores the table, and the seeded one alone by a mock that never returns the defaults. A separate fixture rather than a second step there because a fixture's seed precedes every query step, so one fixture cannot serve both the seeded and the unseeded state.
name: query_reminder_settings_defaults

queries.comment: No `reminders.*` row on either stack: `enabled` is `false` and `time` is the `09:00` default, which is what a fresh install reads until the user opts in.
queries.name: reminder_settings_defaults
